canonical_policy.direct_verification: current direct Airwars endpoint/live-page attempts only; archived copies are separate
canonical_policy.incidents: data/incidents stable IDs enriched with the restored historical structural package
canonical_policy.source_content: primary mutually-exclusive preservation categories; local page generation is not content preservation
canonical_policy.source_references: all historical occurrences plus additional relationships recoverable from normalized provenance

discrepancy_45075_45081.cause: Six source entities recovered from the archived Airwars copy for incident sequence 4771 remained valid local records, but the later full-run worklist was rebuilt from that incident's empty normalized sources array and omitted them. They are source entities, not index/utility pages or duplicate IDs.

direct_airwars_fetch_blocked_403.calculation_method: Count 403 status or circuit evidence regardless of archived-copy recovery.
direct_airwars_fetch_blocked_403.definition: Incidents whose current direct Airwars attempts contain HTTP 403 evidence.

direct_airwars_fetch_other_failure.definition: Direct Airwars attempts neither successful nor evidenced as HTTP 403.

direct_airwars_fetch_success.calculation_method: Classify only direct attempts, excluding page_extraction from archives.
direct_airwars_fetch_success.definition: Incidents whose current direct Airwars endpoint or live-page request succeeded; archived copies do not count.

external_links_blocked.calculation_method: Reachability classifier BLOCKED among checked sources.
external_links_blocked.definition: Checked source entities with explicit block evidence.

external_links_checked.calculation_method: Count source IDs with non-empty attempt_history.
external_links_checked.definition: Unique source entities with at least one recorded public retrieval attempt.

external_links_dead.calculation_method: Reachability classifier DEAD among checked sources.
external_links_dead.definition: Checked source entities with HTTP 404/410 evidence.

external_links_discovered.definition: Distinct raw external source URLs represented by references.

external_links_not_checked.calculation_method: Source entity total minus checked source IDs.
external_links_not_checked.definition: Unique source entities without a recorded public retrieval attempt.

external_links_reachable.calculation_method: Reachability classifier FETCHED among checked sources.
external_links_reachable.definition: Checked source entities with a successful/cached retrieval state.

historical_or_local_text_records.calculation_method: Count non-empty structural descriptions with historical/local in origin.
historical_or_local_text_records.definition: Incident records whose usable structural text originates from a historical/local or mixed origin.

incident_ids_duplicate.calculation_method: Total rows minus distinct incident_id values.
incident_ids_duplicate.definition: Incident rows sharing the same stable identifier.

incident_pages_generated.calculation_method: Count canonical sequence directories with index.html.
incident_pages_generated.definition: Canonical incident pages present in the inspected release.

incident_pages_missing.calculation_method: Canonical sequence page IDs minus generated page IDs.

incident_pages_orphaned.calculation_method: Generated page IDs minus canonical sequence page IDs.
incident_pages_orphaned.definition: Generated incident pages without a canonical incident.

incident_records_total.calculation_method: Count valid JSON records with a stable internal_id.
incident_records_total.definition: Canonical normalized Airwars Syria incident records.

incidents_outside_coordinate_range.definition: World-valid coordinates outside the accepted display range.

incidents_with_malformed_coordinates.definition: Incidents with non-numeric or world-invalid coordinates.

incidents_with_valid_coordinates.definition: Incidents with a world-valid pair inside the accepted display range.

internal_links_broken.definition: Internal hyperlinks whose target does not exist.

internal_links_checked.definition: Internal hyperlinks checked by the release validator.

local_source_entity_pages_generated.calculation_method: Count canonical source IDs with an index page.
local_source_entity_pages_generated.definition: Local pages describing unique source entities; this does not assert content preservation.

records_without_usable_incident_text.definition: Incidents without an original narrative, archived narrative, or historical structured summary.

source_record_files_total.definition: Unique external source entity records stored locally.

source_record_ids_duplicate.definition: Source files sharing a stable source_id.

source_reference_duplicate_relationships.calculation_method: Count reference rows whose duplicate_relationship attribute is true.
source_reference_duplicate_relationships.definition: Reference occurrences explicitly identified as a repeated incident-to-raw-URL relationship; retained rather than deduplicated away.

source_reference_malformed_urls.calculation_method: Count reference rows whose malformed attribute is true.
source_reference_malformed_urls.definition: Reference rows whose raw URL could not be normalized to a valid HTTP(S) URL.

source_reference_manual_review.calculation_method: Count reference rows whose manual_review attribute is true.
source_reference_manual_review.definition: Reference rows explicitly marked for manual review.

source_reference_pages_generated.calculation_method: Count canonical reference IDs with an index page.
source_reference_pages_generated.definition: Local pages representing individual incident-to-source occurrences.

source_reference_pages_missing.calculation_method: Canonical reference IDs minus generated page IDs.
source_reference_pages_missing.definition: Canonical reference occurrences without a local page.

source_reference_pages_orphaned.calculation_method: Generated reference page IDs minus canonical IDs.
source_reference_pages_orphaned.definition: Reference pages without a canonical reference record.

source_reference_records_total.calculation_method: Union historical occurrences with additional provenance relationships absent from the historical rows; preserve duplicates.
source_reference_records_total.canonical_input: historical package cases/*/data.json + normalized source provenance + normalized incident sources
source_reference_records_total.definition: Every incident-to-source occurrence, including duplicates and locally recovered relationships.

source_reference_url_reuse_occurrences.calculation_method: Total non-empty raw-URL rows minus distinct raw URL strings.
source_reference_url_reuse_occurrences.definition: Reference occurrences beyond the first occurrence of each distinct raw URL across the whole archive.

sources_blocked.definition: Source entities without text whose recorded attempts show a public-access block (401/403/429/451 or explicit block evidence).

sources_dead.definition: Source entities without text whose attempts returned 404 or 410.

sources_duplicate_content.calculation_method: Count records in hash groups of size greater than one.
sources_duplicate_content.definition: Source records participating in a non-empty identical content-hash group.

sources_full_text_archived.definition: Source entities with validated complete text obtained from a public archived copy.

sources_full_text_direct.definition: Source entities with non-empty text that passed quality validation as complete and came from direct public retrieval.

sources_full_text_local_snapshot.definition: Source entities with validated complete text preserved only in a local snapshot.

sources_link_only.definition: Source entities with a preserved URL but neither text nor metadata nor stronger failure state.

sources_malformed.calculation_method: Primary mutually-exclusive source content classifier; malformed remains a secondary attribute when text exists.
sources_malformed.definition: Source entities without text whose raw URL cannot normalize to an HTTP(S) URL.

sources_metadata_only.definition: Source entities with metadata but no preserved text and no stronger blocked/dead/malformed state.

sources_partial_text.calculation_method: Primary classifier assigns PARTIAL_TEXT when completeness is partial, absent, or quality is not accepted.
sources_partial_text.definition: Source entities with non-empty text not proven to be the complete main text.

sources_requires_manual_review.calculation_method: Distinct source IDs satisfying the review predicate.
sources_requires_manual_review.definition: Source entities with review flags or a manual-review/malformed primary state.

unique_normalized_source_urls.calculation_method: Distinct normalized_url where normalization did not fail.
unique_normalized_source_urls.definition: Distinct successfully normalized HTTP(S) source URLs.

unique_raw_source_urls.definition: Distinct non-empty raw URL evidence values across reference occurrences.
